notes.title: Classic Marathon trilogy on Steam now has Linux support
notes.content:
Originally from Destiny and Halo developer Bungie - Classic Marathon 1, Classic Marathon 2 and Classic Marathon Infinity get Native Linux versions on Steam.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/classic-marathon-trilogy-on-steam-now-has-linux-support/

notes.title: Aleph One 1.11
notes.content: [p]This release is not network compatible with the previous release, and films saved with this release cannot be played back with older releases.[/p][p]Highlights:[/p][list][*][p]Native Steam Linux support[/p][/*][*][p]Audio improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Additional sprite rendering option for 3D perspective[/p][/*][*][p]Replay films for saved games[/p][/*][/list][p]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Numerous audio improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Pauses/resumes in-game audio when the game is paused/resumed[/p][/*][*][p]Intro music now continues to play in preferences dialogs[/p][/*][*][p]Shield/O2 charger now fully loop to prevent pops[/p][/*][*][p]Adds 3D spatialization for stereo sources[/p][/*][*][p]HRTF no longer affects music, streaming sources and 2D sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Fades in ambient sounds when they start playing[/p][/*][*][p]Sound obstruction adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Allow HRTF settings only when stereo + 3D sounds are enabled[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adds a sensitivity/deadzone preference for each controller aim axis ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/525"]#525[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a few cheats to Cheats.lua[/p][/*][*][p]Adds support for Steam Linux including workshop upload[/p][/*][*][p]Films are now recorded when starting from saved games[/p][/*][*][p]Allows viewing terminals when the overhead map is active ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/pull/549"]#549[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a new setting to tilt sprites parallel to the camera when 3D perspective is on[/p][/*][*][p]Shell casings are now interpolated at 60+ fps[/p][/*][*][p](Lua) Adds Game.player accessor for Tag/KTMWTB/Rugby[/p][/*][/list][p]Other fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixes players sprites when gathering a network game ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/527"]#527[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes stats board displayed twice before the epilogue in coop net games[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes hotkey issues with dead players and ball carriers ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/516"]#516[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes aim issues with aim getting stuck when both mouse and joystick are plugged in ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/513"]#513[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes an issue with DPDI and alien weapon ammo ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/509"]#509[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes network-only items not spawning on the first level ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/517"]#517[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes teleporting (local) effects when transiting to another level in coop net games[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes an issue where players can't respawn in net games on some broken maps ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/457"]#457[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Stability improvements to dedicated servers[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to native file dialogs ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/pull/550"]#550[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes window focus loss when replaying a film selected with native file dialog ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/401"]#401[/url])[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes an assertion failure with some Marathon 1 maps ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/533"]#533[/url])[/p][/*][/list][p]Behind the scenes:[/p][list][*][p]Uses libmatroska, libvpx, libyuv and pl_mpeg instead of FFmpeg[/p][/*][*][p]Uses ASIO for networking instead of SDL_net[/p][/*][*][p]Build fix for new versions of Boost ([url="https://github.com/Aleph-One-Marathon/alephone/issues/556"]#556[/url])[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Classic Marathon Trilogy on Steam gets a Beta with Linux support and lots of overall improvements
notes.content:
Classic Marathon, Classic Marathon 2 and Classic Marathon Infinity are getting some big upgrades with a Beta now available to test.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/classic-marathon-trilogy-on-steam-gets-a-beta-with-linux-support-and-lots-of-overall-improvements/

notes.title: Aleph One 1.10.1
notes.content:
Classic Marathon Infinity has been updated to use Aleph One 1.10.1. This is a bug fix release. Highlights:
[list]
[*]Uses HUD filtering preference for Lua HUD images
[*]Physics file is no longer mandatory for gathering using dedicated servers
[*]It is now possible to mix workshop scenarios and local scenarios in the Steam version of Classic Marathon Infinity
[*]Fixes an issue interpolating ephemera
[/list]

notes.title: Classic Marathon Infinity Hotfix
notes.content:
We have posted an update to fix an issue where BoB could invalidate the the Chapel Groan achievement. Traitorous Pig! 

If you had trouble getting the achievement before, resume from a game saved in a prior level and try again.
